reasons: Both quatrains are clean iambic tetrameter with ABAB structure, but A's rhymes (гнёт/встаёт, канале/зале) are full and exact while B's впрок/залог is only an approximate rhyme. A's imagery (Atlanteans, maple leaves on the canal, a raised bridge as a piano lid) is vivid and reads naturally. B's pawnshop conceit is original, but 'считает впрок' is an awkward collocation, and 'подносит к небу под залог' leaves the object only implied, so the syntax is strained.
